full_judgment: 3. During pendency of the said execution case the respondent No. 4 filed an application for releasing .50 Sataks of the attached property stating, inter alia, that the plaintiff-petitioner instituted Money Suit No. 4 of 1998 before the Artha Rin Adalat, Bogra against the respondent Nos. 2 and 3 and got a decree on 12-8-1999 for realisation of Taka 20,58,721 only. The said decree has been put into execution vide Artha Rin Execution Case No. 299 of 1999 before the said Adalat. After filing the execution case an area of 68.50 decimals of land from MR Khatian No. 248 of mouza Sabgram was attached stating that the said land belonged to the loanee Mr Abdus Sattar (respondent No. 2). Respondent No. 4 came to know about the said execution case and about the attachment of land on 18-3-2000 and thereafter filed an application on 19-3-2000 under Order XXI, rule 58 of the Code of Civil Procedure stating that he purchased an area of 50 decimals of land out of the said attached land by 5 kabala deeds date 14-10-1982, 14-10-1982, 17-10-1982, 17-10-1982 and 18-10-1982 respectively and also claimed that this respondent has been in possession in the said case land and thereby the respondent No. 2 has got no right, title and possession and accordingly, the decree holder has got no right to attach the said land.
